items.title: Why Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Shares Are Trading Lower Today
items.summary: Shares of enterprise technology company Hewlett Packard Enterprise (NYSE:HPE) fell 8.6% in the afternoon session after Evercore ISI analyst Amit Daryanani downgraded the company from Outperform to In Line. According to StreetInsider, the move shifts the firm's outlook from a bullish stance to a neutral position.
